title: Book One · Chapter 90: Mei Wants a Different Picture
story:
The project pages are going on the classroom wall.

Miss Wu gives each group one large sheet. They may choose three results to show. The rest will stay in their folders.

Ronan wants their best boat at the top. It carried all three stones in the middle. The drawing could be large, with blue water all round it.

Mei shakes her head.

“I want the side view too.”

“People can see the top.”

“The top view does not show the water line.”

She draws the side of a little boat. The water came up to this thin line. The wood almost touches it. Ronan wants people to see their floating boat. But the water is close to the top in this picture. He wants the picture without that water line.

“It did not sink.”

“I did not draw it sinking.”

Leo comes over with paste on one finger. “You should put mine beside it. Mine was lower.”

“This is our sheet,” Mei says.

“I meant lower in the water.”

“I heard you.”

Leo goes back to wash his finger. Ronan looks at Mei. She said no to both boys. Her voice stayed quiet.

“Can I do anything on the picture?” he asks.

“Yes. Draw the stones in their right places.”

He starts with three large circles. Mei points to the small space between the wooden pieces.

“They were close together.”

“I know.”

“Then show that.”

He puts the pencil down too hard. The point breaks.

Miss Wu looks up. Ronan waits for her to come over. He wants Miss Wu's decision. She points at the spare pencils instead.

“Talk about the page. Tell each other your ideas. Then I will look.”

Ronan goes to the teacher's desk. He uses the little covered sharpener for his pencil. He has a whole minute away from Mei and her water line.

He returns to the table. Mei has two small test drawings on scraps. One has the top view. One has the side view. Each drawing is small. There is room for both on the sheet.

He moves the scraps around. The page begins to look less crowded.

“We could put the empty boat here,” he says.

Mei nods. “Then people can compare.”

They arrange the three pictures. Ronan draws the stones smaller this time. He leaves room for a short sentence beneath each.

Mei asks him to write the sentences. She will check the drawing names. He reads the first sentence aloud. Then he writes it on the large sheet.

Their page changed during the work. Both children changed their first plans. The top boat is smaller. The side view has its water line. Their names are the same size at the bottom.

Miss Wu comes to look. She points at the second picture.

“What does this tell me?”

Ronan explains the middle stones. Mei explains the low side. The teacher asks them to make one word darker. Then she gives them a place on the wall.

After class, another child stands in front of their page. She looks at the top picture and the side view. “Did the water reach the stones?” she asks Ronan.

“No,” he says. “See this line?”

He points at Mei's line. She is packing her own bag. She does not see him point to the line. He tells her before she leaves.
studyGuide:
## 重点表达

- side view＝侧面图
- compare＝比较
- crowded＝拥挤的
- first plans＝最初的计划

额外情节词（不要求本章全部记住）：sharpener＝卷笔刀；paste＝浆糊；water line＝水位线。

## 读句提示

**Did the water reach the stones?**

水／有没有到达／石头那里？直接问句保留问题的完整顺序。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan为什么起初不喜欢侧面水线图？
2. 最后的页面怎样结合了两个人的想法？
